<ic>Disbursal of money with the intention of giving 50 wains of Weirwood to the Ambassador for the Asavean Archipelago for reparations requested for the piracy by Imperial Citizens.<br><br>
''Raised by Temeschwar, seconded by Sarvos''</ic>

===Overview===
* Request for funds to pay for the purchase of weirwood as a gift to the ''plenum'' of the [[Asavean Archipelago]].

===Date===
* Summer 378YE

===Outcome===
* While the gift was passed in principle, no funds were allocated from the Imperial Treasury to pay for the purchase of weirwood
